title: TypeError when using middlewares
body: ### 🐛 Current behavior I would like to use middlewares like described here: https://www.algolia.com/doc/api-reference/widgets/middleware/vue/#examples If I return the subscribe function like `function middleware({ instantSearchInstance }) { return { subscribe() { // Do something when the InstantSearch instance starts. }, } }` \`\ .....\` I get this error in the console: `vue-instantsearch_vue3_es.js?v=5425bfd0:12830 Uncaught TypeError: (n6 || []).filter is not a function` * vue 3.4.21 * vue instantsearch 4.15.0 ### 🔍 Steps to reproduce * create a function like https://www.algolia.com/doc/api-reference/widgets/middleware/vue/#examples * add to the instant search instance * reload page * open console ### Live reproduction code sandbox has a node js error... ### 💭 Expected behavior I expect to not see a javascript error ### Package version vue instantsearch 4.15.0 ### Operating system macOS 14.4.1 ### Browser 1.64.116 ### Code of Conduct * \[X] I agree to follow this project's Code of Conduct
